annotations.title: Compare the terms of two fund documents side by side

description: Side-by-side comparison of the terms of two fund documents: two limited partnership agreements (LPAs), or one fund's LPA and its subscription agreement. You read the documents and send the terms you found (fee, carry, hurdle, waterfall, clawback, removal, notice days, governing law and about 20 more, each a number or a fixed choice). Get back the terms side by side, which differ, which side is usually friendlier to the investor where that is clear, and, for an LPA plus subscription agreement, whether they agree and whether the investor representations fit the fund's stated exemptions (3(c)(7), Rule 506(c), the ERISA 25 percent test), with the sources and the date each rule was last amended, and a signed record. Set check_sources true to also ask the eCFR (official) whether any of those four rules was amended after the date this tool was written. Free. No model, nothing stored. It does NOT read documents, give legal or investment advice, or say a term is acceptable; do not send names, account numbers or document text.

label.description: Optional plain name for this document, e.g. 'Fund I LPA'. Not a person, account or address.

terms.description: The terms you read in the document. Leave out any you did not find. Only these names are accepted.

accredited_verification.description: Subscription requires evidence of accredited status, not just a statement

audited_annual_financials.description: Audited annual financial statements are promised

benefit_plan_investor_rep.description: Subscription asks whether the investor is a benefit-plan investor

capital_call_notice_days.description: Days of notice before a capital call is due

carried_interest_pct.description: Carried interest (share of profits to the manager), percent

clawback.description: Manager must give back excess carry at the end

default_penalty.description: Consequence of missing a capital call

extension_years_total.description: Total years the term can be extended

fee_basis_after_investment_period.description: What the fee is charged on after the investment period

fee_offset.description: How much of the manager's other fees reduce the management fee

fund_exemption.description: Investment Company Act exclusion the fund relies on (section 3(c)(1) or 3(c)(7))

gp_commitment_pct.description: Manager's own commitment, percent of total commitments

gp_liability_standard.description: Level of fault at which the manager loses indemnity

investment_period_years.description: Years the manager may make new investments

investor_rep_accredited.description: Subscription asks the investor to represent it is an accredited investor

investor_rep_qualified_purchaser.description: Subscription asks the investor to represent it is a qualified purchaser

key_person.description: What happens if named key people leave

lpac.description: There is an investor advisory committee

management_fee_pct.description: Annual management fee, percent of the fee basis

no_fault_removal.description: Investors can remove the manager without cause

offering_exemption.description: Securities Act exemption for the offering (Rule 506(b) or 506(c))

plan_assets_limit_25pct.description: Fund limits benefit-plan investors to under 25 percent (ERISA plan-assets test)

removal_vote_pct.description: Share of investor interests needed for removal, percent

term_years.description: Fund term in years, before extensions

transfer_requires_gp_consent.description: An investor needs the manager's consent to transfer

waterfall.description: How profits are split: across the whole fund, a mix, or deal by deal
